import math, numpy as np, nuka, window_input as w
s = app.actions.run('window.state')
gx, gy = w.grab_point(s)
w.drive(app, [('move', gx, gy), ('down',), ('up',), ('wait', 0.3)])
l = app.actions.run('robot.links')['links']
t = [i for i, x in enumerate(l) if x['joint'] == 'tool_mount'][0]
pose = lambda: np.asarray(app.world.download_field(nuka.Field.ARTICULATION_LINK_POSE), dtype=np.float64).reshape(-1, 7)[t, :3].copy()
elbow = lambda: [j['q'] for j in app.actions.run('robot.joints')['joints'] if j['name'] == 'elbow'][0]
p0, e0 = pose(), elbow()
v = app.actions.run('view.view')
r, eye, aim = v['rect'], np.array(v['eye']), np.array(v['target'])
f = (aim - eye) / np.linalg.norm(aim - eye)
right = np.cross(f, [0.0, 0.0, 1.0])
right /= np.linalg.norm(right)
up = np.cross(right, f)
d = p0 - eye
th = math.tan(math.radians(v['fov']) / 2.0)
nx = d.dot(right) / (d.dot(f) * th * r['width'] / r['height'])
ny = d.dot(up) / (d.dot(f) * th)
x = s['x'] + r['x'] + (nx * 0.5 + 0.5) * r['width']
y = s['y'] + r['y'] + (0.5 - ny * 0.5) * r['height']
w.drag(app, x, y, -60, -40)
for _ in range(20):
    app.update(True)
p1, e1 = pose(), elbow()
print('GIZMO_IK', (x, y), p0, p1, e0, e1)
assert np.linalg.norm(p1 - p0) > 0.01 and abs(e1 - e0) > 0.01, (p0, p1, e0, e1)
